name: WDUi Framework SDK
changes_cs: Aktualizovany WDUi Framework SDK: proprietarni binarni x64 SDK s hlavickami, wdui.lib, default skiny/fonty, binarnim demo a otevrenou ukazkou pouziti bez zdrojovych cpp souboru knihovny. Tato verze snizuje Direct2D interop latenci lazy batchovanim nativnich DC draw operaci a pridava diagnostiku direct2DNativeBatchBeginCountForDiagnostics().
changes_en: Updated WDUi Framework SDK: proprietary binary x64 SDK with headers, wdui.lib, default skins/fonts, binary demo, and an open usage example without library cpp sources. This version reduces Direct2D interop latency by lazy-batching native DC draw operations and adds the direct2DNativeBatchBeginCountForDiagnostics() diagnostic counter.
